feeds.title: The Petite Cook
feeds.description: Former marketing manager Andrea Soranidis began The Petite Cook to share her love of food, experimenting in the kitchen, and travel. Although she is a self-taught chef, the majority of recipes on the blog are developed by Andrea and inspired by her travels across the world.

feeds.title: BBC Good Food
feeds.description: We're all about good recipes, and about quality home cooking that everyone can enjoy. Whether you're looking for some healthy inspiration or learning how to cook a decadent dessert, we've trustworthy guidance for all your foodie needs. eating well is everything. Follow us for daily food inspiration from Britain's no1 food media brand.

feeds.title: The Picky Glutton
feeds.description: I am sPicky Glutton and this is my restaurant reviews blog where I aim to review every restaurant I dine at. With so many places to eat, the last place you want to go is somewhere deeply disappointing or, perhaps even worse, somewhere forgettably mediocre and yawningly average. To help you out, I will endeavour to finish each review with a firm recommendation either way and a rating out of 5.

feeds.title: Gousto Blog
feeds.description: Find all the latest recipes, quick dinner ideas, interviews and kitchen hacks. Our mission at Gousto is to make it easy to cook quick, delicious and exciting meals at home with high quality ingredients.

feeds.title: My Fussy Eater
feeds.description: Latest recipes on 15 minute meals, kid-friendly snacks, hidden veggie recipes, gluten-free, vegan, nut-free, egg-free and more. My Fussy Eater is packed with healthy eating recipes and fun food ideas that even the pickiest of eaters will love.

feeds.title: Sugar Free Londoner
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Katrin! Sugar Free Londoner is a blog dedicated to delicious family food without added sugar. You'll find these pages packed with easy and tasty gluten free and low carb recipes all tested in my London kitchen as well as interesting facts and information around sugar, healthy eating and well-being.

feeds.title: The Mayfair Foodie Blog
feeds.description: Hello & welcome to The Mayfair Foodie website. I was born in London & have always had a passion for all things food related. This website is an extension of my passion bringing you everything good about the food & hospitality scene in Mayfair. Bon Appetit!

feeds.title: baste cut fold
feeds.description: Explore a delectable showcase of dessert recipes. Rebecca Frey merges her design background and pastry expertise to create and share dessert recipes that look and taste great! She is a professional costume designer, wardrobe stylist, recipe developer, food writer, photographer/stylist, and classically trained pastry chef.

feeds.title: Sandhya's Kitchen
feeds.description: Sandhya's Kitchen is an amalgamation of my obsession for food photography & styling along with cooking. With easy to follow recipes, I show you how to make great-tasting Vegetarian /Vegan food without the hassle.

feeds.title: Supergolden Bakes
feeds.description: Supergolden Bakes by Lucy P is all about sweet, savoury and everything in between. Lucy P a London-based recipe developer, food photographer, coffee fanatic and cocktail appreciator. Obsessed with all things food!

feeds.title: Fuss Free Flavours
feeds.description: I'm Helen. I'm a freelance food writer and recipe developer based in West London. I've grown and developed this blog to include recipe development, reviews and food travel. Food has now become my full time job and I work on a commissioned freelance basis.

feeds.title: A Mummy Too
feeds.description: Emily Leary is a food, lifestyle, and parenting writer and presenter and a mummy too. Emily founded A Mummy Too in 2011 as a food and lifestyle blog for busy parents. It was born out of a love of family, food and photography. The site is the place to come for daily recipes as it features more than 300. It is proof that a shortage of spare time shouldn't mean you can't enjoy beautiful things.

feeds.title: SilverSpoon London » Restaurants
feeds.description: A Luxury Lifestyle and Travel and food blog.I'm always keen to try the latest restaurants and bars as well as revisit old classics.

feeds.title: The Flexitarian
feeds.description: Flexitarians (aka Flexible Vegetarians) have a plant-based diet. They helps you go meat free with its vegetarian and vegan recipes. Eat less meat , get healthy , save the planet.

feeds.title: Supper in the Suburbs
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Supper in the Suburbs and food and lifestyle blog based in North London. I'm Emma. A self confessed junk food vegan who has been blogging cakes, cocktails and other tasty dishes for the last 10 years! Dive in and take a look at some of my favourite, tried and tested recipes.

feeds.title: ET Food Voyage
feeds.description: ET Food Voyage is a food blog showcasing the best of halal-friendly eateries around London and beyond, and sharing fun recipes to make at home.

feeds.title: Cheese and Biscuits
feeds.description: A place to find hyperbolic, ill-researched but hopefully entertaining reviews of mainly London restaurants.

feeds.title: Halal Food Guy
feeds.description: Halal restaurants reviews around London. Discover new restaurants around London that serve Halal food. Images, reviews and restaurant map.

feeds.title: The English Kitchen
feeds.description: The English Kitchen by Marie Rayner contains posts on good food and great recipes. Marie will endeavour to show you how to cook whatever it is I am cooking in the very best possible way, and hopefully we can all have some fun, and a few laughs along the way. Simple ingredients, simple methods, fantastic flavours. That is my promise to you.

feeds.title: Ceri Jones Chef
feeds.description: I'm Ceri Jones, a professional chef, lover of seasonal produce, recipe writer and supper club host.

feeds.title: Her Favourite Food
feeds.description: London based restaurant, food and travel blog. A London food blog that features reviews of restaurants, foodie events, travel, pop-up dining experiences, food festivals, food markets, food tours and so much more

feeds.title: Dom in the Kitchen
feeds.description: My name is Dominic, I am a cook, food writer and creative event producer. The cooking on my blog features many of our local produce and is as seasonal as can be. I love sharing my recipes and ideas with you and hopefully the result is that you eat and of course, enjoy!

feeds.title: London Food Blog
feeds.description: London Food and Travel Blog

feeds.title: Eat Cook Explore
feeds.description: London Food and Travel Blogger who loves eating out and exploring the world.Travel Stories, Restaurant Reviews, Recipe Development,Top Chefs, Food Producers, Favourite Recipes, Cooking, Baking. Voted top 10 Gastronomy Blog in the UK in 2017.

feeds.title: Social Pantry
feeds.description: With a dedicated team of experienced chefs, event planners, and waiting staff, Social Pantry is the go-to London caterer for events, the workplace, and much more. From handy catering tips to healthy eating ideas and delicious, simple recipes, the Social Pantry blog is a top London food blog...

feeds.title: Tasty Food for Busy Mums
feeds.description: My name is Slaveya and I'm a London-based food blogger, wife and a busy mum! I love tasty food! I can't think of anything I don't like. You can find a variety of recipes here - from a low-calorie 'clean' meal to a bit naughty but delicious recipe. No matter what though, my recipes are quick, easy and delicious.

feeds.title: Caroline Makes
feeds.description: Cooking, baking, cake decorating, meal plans, recipe ideas, dinner menus, product reviews, restaurant reviews, crafts, card making.

feeds.title: Drea's Dainty Kitchen
feeds.description: hi! I'm Andrea Dawkins. Here you will find a selection of easy-to-follow recipes that have all been tried and tested in my kitchen. New recipes are added weekly with many being healthy and nutritious but here we believe in balance so you'll also find some sweet treats too!

feeds.title: Poetry of Spices
feeds.description: Poetry Of Spices authored by Mini is a food blog that shares daily creative and easy, healthy vegetarian and vegan recipes with a flavor of Indian spices. Explore finely curated menus and recipes that inspire home cooking and nudge families around the world towards a more ethical, sustainable, and healthy dinner table.

feeds.title: The Worktop
feeds.description: The Worktop by Tina Jui is a London Brunch Guide. The blog contains Favorite breakfast and brunch recipes.

feeds.title: The London Foodie
feeds.description: Reviews of London's best value, good quality restaurants, articles on featured ingredients, recipes and my thoughts on London's food scene. My aim is to bring a cosmopolitan view of eating out & cooking in London, and as a guide to anyone looking for new ideas in our capital.

feeds.title: Walking Around London » Youtube
feeds.description: Find videos on London food and restaurants by Walking Around London.

feeds.title: End of the fork
feeds.description: A guide to good food: restaurant reviews, recipes, cooking tips and products.

feeds.title: Halal Girl About Town
feeds.description: Tired of eating the same typical halal food almost 10 years ago, Layla Hassanali made it her mission to find restaurants around London that both catered for halal and offered something a little different. What started as a 'blog' back in 2012 to journal all of the exciting new food and travel finds, HGAT has now evolved to become the UK's biggest halal food and travel platform dedicated to discovering the best halal restaurants in the country, Muslim-friendly travel destinations and more.

feeds.title: Cooksister
feeds.description: Blogger Jeanne Horak-Druiff features food, photos, and faraway places on Cook Sister. She moved to London 14 years ago from South Africa and works in law alongside her blogging career. As a freelance recipe developer and writer, Jeanne has spoken at blogging conferences, covering topics from the legal aspects of blogging to recipe writing and editing.

feeds.title: London Eater
feeds.description: It is a London food blog and restaurant reviews and restaurant guide and a gastro-centric survival guide for Londoners.

feeds.title: Catch 52 » Reviews
feeds.description: London based travel blog and food blog. Exploring and eating my way around the world.

feeds.title: Food Goblin
feeds.description: Food, Drinks, Travel, Me. Come here for restaurant reviews, travel and drink guides and generally....all the good stuff.

feeds.title: Scott Can Eat
feeds.description: My name is Scott. Food has always been the stuff that feeds my belly and feeds my mind. I love to eat and I've been pretty good at it for the last 40ish years. From the street to fine dining I love it all... except for raisins and bananas. I hate raisins and bananas.

feeds.title: Maison Cupcake
feeds.description: Blogger Sarah Trivuncic describes herself as a 'Cake Coveter and Homeware Horder,' and her site Maison Cupcake specialises in food, life and travel. In 2009 Sarah started blogging about making cupcakes, writing recipes and taking photos. When she finished her project she realised that she didn't want to stop blogging, so she just kept going. She specialises in all types of baking, not just cupcake

feeds.title: The Massamen
feeds.description: Good food. Great deals. PREMIUM banter. We bring you all the best restaurants in London.

feeds.title: Jagruti's Cooking Odyssey
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Hayley, daughter of Jagruti. Welcome to my blog. Delicious and easy to follow pure vegetarian, vegan and eggless baking recipes from India and other global cuisines.

feeds.title: Eating Europe
feeds.description: Our award-winning food tours help you to taste the best foods of Rome, Florence, London, Amsterdam and Prague. Check out amazing places to visit and eat in London here.

feeds.title: Ruby Violet Blog
feeds.description: Ruby Violet creates bespoke ice creams, sorbets and frozen delights using only organic milk and the finest fresh ingredients. We use organic milk, free range eggs and fresh fruit to produce small batches of ice cream and vegan sorbets in our kitchen at the back of our parlour in Tufnell Park, North London.

feeds.title: Choccywoccydoodah » Youtube
feeds.description: Unique handmade chocolate & cakes. Brighton Lanes and London Carnaby. Decadent self indulgence.

feeds.title: Sharking for chips and drinks...
feeds.description: London's leading food, drink and travel online guide with contributors covering all things culinary in Asia and Australia.

feeds.title: Food Diaries London
feeds.description: A crazy foodie lost in the streets of London! Base: London.

feeds.title: Table To Paper
feeds.description: Table To Paper is a Food, Travel and Lifestyle Blog with a focus on unique experiences, aesthetics and design.

feeds.title: A Spoonful Of Sugar
feeds.description: This is a blog about all things foodie. Favourite meals, favourite recipes, favourite delis and restaurants, favourite food websites and books plus some amazing food photography.

feeds.title: The Bearded Bakery
feeds.description: The Bearded Bakery is a a blog specialised in male lifestyle, baking and travelling through the eyes of a London based man.
